About the Team
The Uber Freight team is building a better future for shipping. We believe that when shippers and carriers have the freedom to move together, the entire industry moves ahead. Our teams design and build innovative applications, distributed systems, and real-time models to power our global logistics marketplace, spanning the Carrier experience, high-throughput Shipper enterprise portals, internal operations tooling, and core pricing, matching, and forecasting engines.
About the Role
As a  Fullstack Engineer at Uber Freight, you will be instrumental in designing and building end-to-end systems that power our logistics platform, from backend services and APIs to the React-based web interfaces used by our customers. You will work at the intersection of user experience and business logic, partnering across product, design, and fellow engineering teams to deliver seamless, scalable solutions.
What You Will Do
Build End-to-End Applications : Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable fullstack services and interfaces using modern technologies like Go/Java and React.
Lead System Architecture : Drive technical design and architectural decisions for systems spanning both frontend user interfaces and backend distributed services.
Champion Engineering Excellence : Advocate for best practices across testing, security, code maintainability, and deployment pipelines to elevate the engineering bar.
Drive Scoping & Product Delivery : Partner closely with Product, Design, and Data Science to define technical scope, navigate trade-offs, and deliver complex logistics features.
Shape the Technical Roadmap : Proactively identify technical debt, scale bottlenecks, and architectural opportunities to influence the long-term technical direction of the platform.
Own Production Health : Troubleshoot and resolve complex, cross-layer issues across both frontend and backend systems in production environments.
Basic Qualifications
BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum 3 years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years working across both backend and frontend systems.
Strong coding skills in one or more backend languages (Go, Java, Python, or C++) and frontend technologies (React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS).
Experience building scalable microservices and frontend applications integrated with APIs.
Deep understanding of web performance, API design, and data modeling.
Experience with testing practices across backend and frontend (unit, integration, and end-to-end).
Preferred Qualifications
Knowledge of data structures and algorithms and the ability to use them practically when implementing solutions.
Experience with one of the following databases: MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle.
Proven track record of leading technical projects and mentoring engineers.
Familiarity with frontend component libraries and design systems.
Strong product sense and attention to UX quality.
Knowledge of the logistics and transportation industry.
